nodes.title: START HERE ===>
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"# START HERE — Project State
    \n


This node creates, loads and manages your SeedHunter projects.


## Create a new project


1. Enter a unique name in **project_name**.

2. Click **CREATE NEW PROJECT**.

3. Check **PROJECT STATUS**.


A new project should show:


- `0 stored clip(s)`

- `next clip 1`

- `revision 1`


The project folder and required subfolders are created automatically.


Before accepting the first clip, set the desired aspect ratio and generation settings. The aspect ratio becomes locked after the first accepted clip.


## Resume an existing project


1. Click **REFRESH PROJECT LIST**.

2. Select the project under **AVAILABLE PROJECTS**.

3. Click **LOAD / REFRESH PROJECT**.


Loading a project restores its active clip number, accepted timeline, continuation source and saved workflow settings.


After opening ComfyUI or switching projects, always load the project before starting a new render.


## Save the current workflow state


Click **SAVE CURRENT PROJECT STATE** after changing important workflow settings, prompts, references or generation options.


This saves the project-specific workflow state so it can be restored later. Accepted clips and project media are already stored separately when a clip is accepted.


## Continue from an earlier clip


Use **CONTINUE FROM CLIP** when you want to replace later clips and branch from an earlier accepted result.


Select the last clip you want to keep. Clips after that point remain stored in the project history, but are removed from the active timeline.


## Important


- Do not manually edit the project-controlled paths.

- Accept a completed clip only once.

- Confirm the project name and next clip number before rendering.

- Use **LOAD / REFRESH PROJECT** after restarting ComfyUI.

nodes.title: PREVIEW & FINAL PASS CONTROLS CONTROLS EXPLAINED
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"# PREVIEW & FINAL PASS CONTROLS
    \n


Use this group to choose the video format and switch between preview scouting, final refinement and single-pass rendering.

## 1. Set the format


In **FORMAT**, choose:


- **preview_megapixels:** resolution used for the three fast preview candidates;

- **single_pass_megapixels:** resolution used in Single Pass mode;

- **aspect_ratio:** format used by previews and final renders;

- **final_pass_megapixels:** target resolution for the selected final pass.


Set the aspect ratio before accepting the first project clip. Once a project contains accepted clips, its aspect ratio is locked to keep the complete timeline compatible.


## 2. Preview mode — generate three candidates


Click **RESTORE PREVIEW MODE** before scouting a new clip.


Set or randomize the seed in **START / REROLL THREE PREVIEWS**:


- keep the current seed to reproduce the same candidates;

- click **Manual Random Seed** to create a new set of preview candidates.


Make sure no preview is selected and the final pass is disabled. Then click **Run** to generate the enabled preview candidates at the preview resolution.


## 3. Choose one preview


After reviewing the candidates, use **CHOOSE PREVIEW FOR FINAL PASS**.


Set exactly one option to `yes`:


- **Enable SELECT PREVIEW 1**

- **Enable SELECT PREVIEW 2**

- **Enable SELECT PREVIEW 3**


The selected preview is used as the source for the high-resolution final pass. The other preview branches are bypassed automatically.


## 4. Run the final pass


After selecting a preview, set:


**Enable HYBRID FINAL UPSCALE PASS → yes**


Click **Run** again. Only the selected preview is refined at **final_pass_megapixels**.


Do not reroll the seed or generate a new preview set between selecting a candidate and running its final pass.


After completing or accepting the clip, click **RESTORE PREVIEW MODE** before scouting the next clip.


## 5. Single Pass mode


To skip preview scouting, click **TURN ON SINGLE PASS**.


Single Pass mode renders one final candidate directly at **single_pass_megapixels**. Preview selection and the hybrid final upscale pass are not required.


Use **RESTORE PREVIEW MODE** when you want to return to the three-preview workflow.


## After restarting ComfyUI


Load the project with **LOAD / REFRESH PROJECT** before continuing. This restores and reapplies the saved mode, preview selection and final-pass controls.


## Important


- Select only one preview for the final pass.

- Do not accept a low-resolution preview as the finished project clip.

- Accept the result only after its final or single-pass render is complete.

- Do not manually change anything in the **INTERNAL** section.

nodes.title: ROLLING CONTINUATION — START CLIP & AV CONTEXT Explained
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

# ROLLING CONTINUATION — CLIP & AUDIO CONTEXT


This group prepares the correct starting point, video source, audio source and continuation context for the current project clip.


Most values are controlled automatically by the loaded project. Normally, only the audio mode and external audio inputs require user attention.


## Current project clip


**CURRENT PROJECT CLIP** shows the clip number that will be generated next.


This value comes from the active project manifest:


- a new project starts at clip `1`;

- accepting a finished clip advances the project automatically;

- loading a project restores its current clip number;

- using **CONTINUE FROM CLIP** recalculates the next clip number.


Do not change the clip index manually.


Before rendering, confirm that this number matches the clip you intend to create.


## Starting mode and project source


**START — new clip / seamless extension** is configured from the active project state.


### Clip 1


For the first project clip:


- `start_mode` is **new clip**;

- no previous project video is required;

- generation starts from the reference images and prompt.


### Clip 2 and later


After accepting a clip:


- `start_mode` becomes **extend video**;

- the project supplies the correct previous accepted video;

- the project supplies the saved continuation latent;

- the required visual and audio overlap is extracted automatically.


The displayed **PROJECT SOURCE** is read-only and shows which accepted project video is being used.


Always check the preview before rendering. It should show the end of the active project timeline from which the new clip must continue.


## use_source_audio


Keep **use_source_audio** enabled when the project source contains usable audio.


This allows the workflow to preserve the incoming audio context and maintain continuity across the seam.


Disable it only when deliberately extending a source video without usable audio. The workflow can then provide correctly timed silence for the existing section.


For normally accepted SeedHunter project clips, this setting should remain enabled.


## Audio mode


Choose the required mode in **AUDIO MODE**.


The selected audio mode is saved with the project state.


### Locked audio


Use **locked audio** when the project must follow an existing master soundtrack exactly.


Connect the complete soundtrack to **master_audio**. The workflow automatically calculates the correct position in that track for the current clip.


The master audio should remain unchanged throughout the project.


### Audio reference


Use **audio reference** when MiniMax should generate new audio while following one or more example recordings.


Connect the required recordings to:


- **reference_1**

- **reference_2**

- **reference_3**


Only enable references that are actually used. Explain the purpose of every enabled audio reference in the prompt.


Audio references guide qualities such as voice, accent, delivery or sound style. Their duration does not determine the generated clip duration.


### Generate audio


Use **generate audio** when MiniMax should create the dialogue, ambience and other sound directly from the prompt.


No external master track or audio reference is required.


Describe the desired speech, performance, timing and environmental sound clearly in the prompt.


## Protected overlap


**PREVIEW — preserve source AV overlap** prepares the incoming audiovisual context for an extension.


It automatically uses:


- the previous accepted video;

- the previous saved context latent;

- the selected audio mode;

- the required overlap length;

- the calculated starting position in the master audio.


The beginning of an extension is protected context. It continues the ending of the previous clip and is removed as duplicate duration during final assembly.


Do not place an abrupt cut, completely new action or important new dialogue entirely inside this protected opening section.


## Locked song position


**LOCKED SONG START** calculates where the current clip belongs on the master soundtrack.


The calculation uses the project clip number, generated frame count, overlap and frame rate. It ensures that every clip receives the correct section of the same master audio.


This is an internal calculation. Do not edit its formula or inputs manually.


## Project-controlled settings


The following values are restored or calculated automatically:


- current clip number;

- new-clip or extension mode;

- previous accepted project video;

- previous saved context latent;

- source preview;

- overlap length;

- clip start position in locked audio;

- last saved audio mode;

- saved master audio and reference-audio selections.


Use **LOAD / REFRESH PROJECT** after opening ComfyUI or switching projects to reapply these values.


## Before every render


Confirm that:


1. the correct project is loaded;

2. the current clip number is correct;

3. the project-source preview shows the expected video;

4. the required audio mode is selected;

5. the correct master audio or audio references are connected;

6. the prompt continues the incoming picture, motion and sound.


Do not manually edit project-controlled paths or internal calculation nodes.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":980,"height":860}

nodes.title: WELCOME / WORKFLOW OVERVIEW
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

# Maartificial H3 SeedHunter — Long-Form Video


This workflow creates longer MiniMax H3 videos from a sequence of individually generated clips while preserving visual motion, audio and project continuity.


It combines SeedHunter preview selection, optional high-resolution refinement, protected audiovisual continuation and non-destructive timeline assembly in one project-based workflow.


## What this workflow can do


- Generate three fast preview candidates for each clip.

- Refine one selected preview at a higher resolution.

- Render directly in Single Pass mode.

- Start a new video or seamlessly continue an accepted clip.

- Preserve visual motion context between consecutive clips.

- Preserve generated speech, ambience or locked soundtrack continuity.

- Use reference images and up to three audio references.

- Follow an exact master soundtrack across multiple clips.

- Store accepted clips and continuation context inside a project.

- Resume a project after restarting ComfyUI.

- Return to an earlier accepted clip and create an alternative continuation.

- Assemble the active timeline into a continuous delivery or master video.

- Keep superseded clips in the project history instead of deleting them.


## Project-based workflow


Every production is stored as a separate SeedHunter project.


A project keeps track of:


- accepted clips;

- the active timeline;

- the next clip number;

- the current continuation source;

- saved visual and audio context;

- aspect ratio and generation format;

- prompts and reference selections;

- preview and final-pass settings;

- project-specific workflow state.


This allows you to switch between productions without manually rebuilding the workflow or searching for the correct continuation files.


Use **PROJECT STATE — CREATE / LOAD / RESUME** to create, load, save or branch a project.


After opening ComfyUI or switching productions, always load the required project before rendering.


## The basic production cycle


Each project follows the same cycle:


1. Create or load the project.

2. Confirm the current project clip and continuation source.

3. Choose the aspect ratio, resolution and audio mode.

4. Load references and write the prompt.

5. Generate preview candidates or use Single Pass mode.

6. Select and render the final result.

7. Review picture, motion, dialogue and audio.

8. Accept the finished clip into the project.

9. Continue with the next clip.

10. Assemble the active timeline whenever required.


The instruction notes beside each control group explain these steps in more detail.


## Non-destructive continuation


Only accepted clips become part of the active project timeline.


When continuing from an earlier clip, later clips are removed from the active timeline but remain stored in the project history. You can therefore experiment with alternative continuations without permanently losing earlier renders.


The assembler always uses the current active timeline.


## Audiovisual continuity


For every extension, the workflow automatically loads the correct previous video and saved latent context.


A protected overlap carries incoming motion and sound into the new generation. During assembly, duplicate overlap duration is removed so it appears only once in the finished timeline.


Available audio modes are:


- **Locked audio:** follow an existing master soundtrack exactly.

- **Audio reference:** generate new audio guided by reference recordings.

- **Generate audio:** create speech, ambience and sound from the prompt.


## Preview, Final Pass and Single Pass


In Preview mode, generate up to three candidates at a lower resolution, select one and refine it at the configured final resolution.


In Single Pass mode, skip preview selection and render one final candidate directly.


Only accept a clip after its intended final render is complete.


## Important principles


- Load the project before starting or resuming work.

- Confirm the project name, clip number and source preview before every render.

- Set the aspect ratio before accepting the first clip.

- Do not manually edit project-controlled paths or internal calculations.

- Accept each completed clip only once.

- Save the current project state after changing important project-specific settings.

- Save the ComfyUI workflow after changing its layout or documentation.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","width":763.6435107904981,"height":550}
